walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Computer Science specification.

Operating Systems appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Operating Systems in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Operating Systems.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
